content.title: Is 'DTF St. Louis' ending soon? Here's how many episodes are left.
content.text: April 4, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ETSpoiler alert! This story includes details from Episodes 1 to 5 of HBO's "DTF St. Louis."So the plot has thickened in HBO's "DTF St. Louis".Det. Donoghue Homer (Richard Jenkins), until now, had believed Floyd's (David Harbour) death to be an open-and-shut case with Clark (Jason Bateman) responsible for his friend's death. But as he and fellow detective Jodie Plumb (Joy Sunday) investigate the incident, possibilities keep arising and pulling them into the twisted love triangle between the two friends and Floyd's wife Carol (Linda Cardellini).With the penultimate episode coming up, "things getting out of hand is a bit of an understatement," Episode 6's logline reads.HBO's limited series is about a "love triangle between three adults experiencing middle-age malaise that leads to one of them ending up dead," according to its synopsis.Clark is a successful weatherman "struggling with the banality of middle age and a sparkless marriage," while Floyd is "an ASL interpreter striving to be a good stepdad." Things take a turn when Floyd is found dead at a community pool, three miles from his house, with a risqué magazine next to him.Here's what to know about when new "DTF St. Louis" episodes release and how to watch them.When do new episodes of 'DTF St. Louis' release? Date, timeEpisode 6 of "DTF St. Louis" will air on HBO on Sunday, April 5, at 9 p.m. ET / PT and will be available to stream on HBO Max at the same time, with new episodes dropping weekly on Sundays.The series finale is scheduled for April 12.How to watch new 'DTF St. Louis' episodesThe seven-episode season will air on HBO at 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT on Sundays and will be available to stream on HBO Max at the same time.Watch 'DTF St. Louis' on HBO Max with SlingNeed a news break? Check out the all-new PLAY hub with puzzles, games and more!Watch 'DTF St. Louis' Episode 6 preview'DTF St. Louis' castThe cast for "DTF St. Louis," according to HBO, includes:Jason Bateman as Clark ForrestDavid Harbour as Floyd SmernitchLinda Cardellini as Carol Love-SmernitchRichard Jenkins as Detective Donoghue HomerJoy Sunday as Detective Jodie PlumbSaman Shafiq is a trending news reporter for USA TODAY.
